long: Bloodborne PSX is a free fan-made demake that reimagines the opening hours of FromSoftware's Bloodborne in the low-poly visual style of a first-generation PlayStation game. Built in Unreal Engine 4, it recreates the gothic city of Yharnam and its challenging melee-and-firearm combat against grotesque enemies. It was created by Lilith Walther as a non-commercial tribute.
